chapters.title: Twitter Space Troubles and Host Introductions
chapters.description: The hosts recover from a Twitter Space glitch, sharing a tip about waiting for Spaces to go live. Ishan Anand welcomes listeners to JavaScript Jam Live, describing it as an open mic for web development, while Anthony Campolo introduces himself and previews the React Miami collaboration with guest Dev Agrawal.

chapters.title: React Miami Month and Community Participation
chapters.description: Scott Steinlage renames the collaboration React Miami Month, promising upcoming React Miami speakers while keeping the familiar JavaScript Jam vibe. He encourages beginners and experts alike to join the conversation, then Dev introduces himself as a fellow media partner, and Dan admits he will miss the conference.

chapters.title: Miami Jam: A Game Show Format for Speakers
chapters.description: Dev reveals Miami Jam, a trivia-style game show replacing typical panel interviews. Michelle, a React Miami organizer, joins and explains the partners have a green light. Dev describes React and JavaScript quirk questions, speaker discussions, and audience point-awarding, with the recording ending around 00:08:42.
